Maya: Thanks everyone for coming — a few quick followups from the AH Q&A. I'll capture owners here.
Alex: Two clarifying Qs from finance/product: Dedicated GA date? APAC region availability?
Maya: Dedicated GA target = end of June; internal beta mid-May. APAC (Singapore) targeted in Q3, partner work ongoing.
Sam: Can we get a short GA criteria doc (latency SLOs, autoscale thresholds, canary pass/fail)? That helps SRE and customers.
Jordan: I'll own the GA criteria doc. Where should it live — Confluence or Console docs?
Jordan: @Maya assigning — I'll publish a summary in Console docs and link to Confluence with the detailed checklist. ETA 2026-06-01.
Maya: Please include the canary checklist + clear rollback steps and the minimum traffic profile for canary.
Rachel: Product action: we need Dedicated pricing tiers for forecasting. @Alex @Sam can you confirm internal estimates?
Alex: I'll sync with Finance and post updated numbers in #pricing by Friday.
eng-bot: doc created: https://confluence.redwood/GA/dedicated-criteria (auto placeholder)
Sam: Also: eval/regression playbook — short doc with thresholds, who to ping, and auto-snooze rules. We should tie that to Redwood Optimize alerts.
Jordan: Adding an 'eval alert' section to the GA doc and will link Optimize dash examples.
Maya: Ownership question: who owns Private deployment SLA support — CX or Eng for first 90 days?
Rachel: Proposed model: Solutions/CS handle onboarding and runbooks; Eng on-call for infra/regression issues; I'll draft a RACI and share.
Maya: TL;DR of owners added here: Jordan -> GA doc + canary checklist; Alex -> pricing numbers; Rachel -> Private deployment RACI; Sam -> eval playbook/alert links. If any conflicts, please flag here by EOD.
Sam: ack, will deliver the playbook draft by Tue.
Alex: got it, will update by Fri.
Jordan: on it, aiming for 2026-06-01.
Rachel: RACI draft by Tue as well.
Maya: I'll post a short recap and links in #announcements after these land. Thanks everyone :heart:
file_notes: post-all-hands follow-up with owners, links, and short action items
